lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical high-contrast line segments visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with greater inter-line distance on the anterior torso (approx. 100-150 pixels) and increased density on the posterior haunch (approx. 40-60 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Multiple line segments on the posterior third of the torso exhibit vertical truncation, failing to extend to the dorsal crest or the ventral fringe. The 4th and 5th lines from the posterior show dashed discontinuities.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is localized on the upper posterior hind limb/haunch area, centered approximately at the midpoint of the thigh verticality.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the posterior haunch align along a horizontal axis, forming a semi-linear geometric arrangement roughly parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns emerge from the skull at a 75-degree upward vector, exhibiting a lyrate spiral that curves laterally outward before converging medially at the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.4 times the combined width of the two horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 12% of the total longitudinal length of each horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A symbiotic bird (Red-billed Oxpecker) is perched on the mid-posterior torso. Prominent white dorsal crest (erect mane) extends from the neck to the base of the tail.
